breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification defines a 2D domain in the X-Y plane, with the height and water column oriented along the Y-axis. However, it incorrectly sets the gravity vector to `(0 0 -9.81)`, which is in the Z-direction. For the simulation to work correctly, gravity should have been set in the negative Y-direction, i.e., `(0 -9.81 0)`.
